quest_gpu_completion.description: Basic profile defaults true. Quest Vulkan only: completion-stage timestamps and supplemental render-pass boundary queries during capture. Two queries per Vulkan pass; no pass splitting or resource readbacks. May affect GPU scheduling; tile subpass costs can remain unresolved. CPU alignment is approximate.
